purpose: Practical integration checklist for agent teams, toolkits, launchpads, and bots. Answer these before wiring Raven in.

checklist.note: Missing optional evidence = coverage gap, never a pass.

checklist.q: Which coverage gaps does YOUR policy accept?
checklist.note: Write them down; the preflight gate example takes them as a list.

checklist.q: What is your receipt staleness window?
checklist.note: Pre-trade/spend/list = re-verify immediately; delayed execution = re-verify at execution time.
Name a human. Agents recommend; humans own.
A failing eval is a build order — report via /integrator-feedback.html.
Fail closed; retry; local MCP fallback where applicable.
Incident: do not trust the receipt; re-run; report.
One workflow, one namespace, accepted-gaps list, staleness window.
Pilot -> beta key (higher limits, optional holder-beta) -> integration tier.

pilotPackage.day0: Integrate the read-only Raven call (hosted or MCP). No wallet access needed.
pilotPackage.day1: Verify signatures against an independently pinned key (/pubkey is a cross-check); store exact receipts per schema.
pilotPackage.day3: Run eval fixtures (/evals.json) and the public smoke checks against your wiring.
pilotPackage.day4: Review coverage gaps hit and any disagreements with your own data.
pilotPackage.day5: Decide: request beta key / expand usage / send integrator feedback.

noPromises: No revenue, trading-performance, safety, or rug-prevention promises. Signed evidence and explicit gaps only.
